structured_output.what_is_happening: The coin is a Solana "Argus" token created directly on PumpSwap about 22 minutes ago. It is not a pump.fun curve graduate: the address has no pump suffix and migrated_unix is 0. Its GeckoTerminal X handle is @arguspad, which belongs to Argus, a launchpad on Circle's Arc chain. That project had its own $ARGUS token that rose about 900% to around $30M market cap when Arc mainnet opened on Sept 16 (https://airdropalert.com/blogs/what-is-argus/, https://arguspad.io/). So this Solana token looks like a copycat borrowing the Arc project's brand and handle. The creator seeded the pool with liquidity larger than the market cap ($45k vs $39k), still holds about 16% of supply, and 100% of the LP is unlocked (RugCheck: danger). Volume ran up about 157% in half an hour: 931 unique buyers against only 52 sellers.

narrative.description: It borrows the brand of the Arguspad launchpad and the ARGUS token on Circle's Arc chain, a recent success story (about 900% on Arc mainnet day, around $30M cap).
narrative.why_spreading: Most likely name recognition from the Arc ARGUS pump, combined with a creator-seeded pool and possibly organized buying. I found no Solana-specific news, no official Arguspad link to Solana, and no posts mentioning this contract.

token_connection.why_this_token: The only link is the GeckoTerminal twitter handle 'arguspad'. The real Argus lives on Arc (EVM), and I found no evidence that Arguspad has launched a Solana token.
token_connection.competing_tokens: The canonical ARGUS is on Arc. There are also several Solana ARGUS/Argus tokens showing about $16-21M 'liquidity' equal to their market cap with zero volume, which is almost certainly fake-pool spam. A separate ARGUS community at t.me/arguscoinsol / arguscoin.info is an older Argus Panoptes meme coin.

authenticity.evidence: Liquidity above market cap means the creator added the pool themselves. The LP is 100% unlocked, the creator holds 16%, GMGN tags 8 bundler wallets, and the 931 buyers vs 52 sellers skew is unusual. There is no DexScreener profile, and I found no organic posts about this contract.
authenticity.uncertainty: X is not readable (402). Buyers may be real people rotating on the Arguspad name.

structural_risks: 100% of LP unlocked and controlled by the creator, who can pull it at any time
Creator holds 15.95% of supply, which can be dumped
Ticker hijack of the Arc project; the real team could disown it

structured_output.counterargument: Arc ARGUS is a real, recent hype story, and a Solana version could draw cross-chain rotation money. 931 unique buyers in 30 minutes is real breadth, GMGN bot rate is 0, and at a $39k market cap a 2x only needs about $40k more buying. The creator's best token reached a $537k all-time-high market cap.

structured_output.thesis: A copycat of the Arc chain's Argus launchpad token, in a creator-seeded PumpSwap pool with fully unlocked LP and a creator holding 16%. Momentum is high and so is the rug risk. With no canonical link, the chance of a 2x before a rug or a -50% drop is below the pool average.
